summary: This bill directs the Election Assistance Commission to create a pilot program providing funds to local educational agencies to inform 12th-grade secondary school students about voter registration.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes appropriations for a pilot program to provide voter registration information to high school students. While it doesn't specify an exact amount, it explicitly states 'such sums as may be necessary,' indicating an increase in government spending to fund this new program.

The primary purpose of this bill is to establish a pilot program to provide voter registration information to 12th-grade students, aiming to increase voter participation among young people. This directly aligns with expanding voting access.
